howToAdd: Copy a committed episodes.jsonl to public/data/runs/committed/<agent>/episodes.jsonl and list it in runs. The deck prefers role=frontier over role=stand-in for the right-hand seat. See site/README.md.

sample.command: uv run --python 3.12 python -m canary.eval --agent solver --tier medium --seeds 3
sample.heuristicCommand: uv run --python 3.12 python -m canary.eval --agent heuristic --tier medium --seeds 3
sample.note: Dev seeds use the public world key, so these files are deterministic. They are a 3-seed sample, not the 40-seed judge table.

runs.label: Reference solver
runs.note: Bundled sample. Episodes may include other tiers later; the deck groups by each line's tier field.

runs.label: Heuristic
runs.note: Stand-in for the frontier seat until a gpt-5.5 file loads.

runs.label: gpt-5.5
runs.note: Absent until the committed run is copied here. When the file parses, it replaces the heuristic on the right.
